purpose: A tool that turns a founder's rough idea into a complete pitch deck, handled behind one conversation by a set of specialists working in different disciplines.
target_audience: Accelerators standardizing deck quality across cohorts

deck_build.description: A founder describes their idea and gets back a full pitch deck. Behind a single assistant that owns the conversation, the work is handled by distinct specialists — one researching the market, one building the financial model, one shaping the narrative, one handling visual design — each working in its own discipline with its own sources and tools, their outputs brought together into one coherent deck.
deck_build.example: "An app for booking last-minute dog walkers" comes back as a 12-slide deck with market sizing, a revenue model, a story arc, and consistent design.

targeted_revision.description: The founder asks for changes and the specialist suited to each change handles it, keeping the deck coherent.

differentiators: Market research, financial modeling, storytelling, and design are each handled by a specialist suited to them rather than competing for one generalist's attention.
